up: Return the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614161. Include the compound ChEMBL ID and the activity standard type.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays a_s JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a_s.tid = md.tid JOIN activities a ON a_s.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a_s.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614161';
